configure_retinanet_objects365: configure a RetinaNet R50 model with FPN for Objects365 v1 detection with 365 classes
set_optimizer_sgd: set SGD optimizer with learning rate 0.01, momentum 0.9, and weight decay 0.0001 for model training
configure_lr_scheduler: configure linear warmup and multi-step learning rate scheduler with milestones at epochs 8 and 11
setup_grad_clipping: setup gradient clipping with max norm 35 and L2 norm type for stable training
configure_auto_scale_lr: configure automatic learning rate scaling based on batch size of 16 across 8 GPUs
